messages.subject: Tweaking the geom point and legend
parts:
Hi all,

I have been going through section 8 of the book,
but the syntax is not clear on how to define geom_point() so that in B&W for publications it uses a different symbol "shape" for each unique variable.

I have tried this geom_point (shape=Species) as when color is used it does create unique colors for each.
But does not seem to work.

Also trying to get the plot X axis labels rotated 90° CCW so they display and are not run together.
The example in section 8 only shows a histogram example.

Hadley perhaps under the default publication theme there could be some integral code the sets all bar, points etc. to unique styles or shapes for points for B&W?

Tnx for guidance

Bruce
